functions.name: resolveThreshold()
functions.purpose: Provides the threshold for the Final Composite score based on the Risk Tier for trade

functions.name: calculateWeightedScores()
functions.purpose: Calcualtes the Weighted Scores for each section based on the responses in that given section of the checklist and then aggregates all the weighted scores into a final composite score

functions.name: evaluateSection1HardStops()
functions.purpose: Test each of the hard stops in this section and returns either True/False and the warning statement associated with any hard stop responses.

functions.name: evaluateSection2HardStops()
functions.purpose: Test each of the hard stops in this section and returns either True/False and the warning statement associated with any hard stop responses.

functions.name: evaluateSection3HardStops()
functions.purpose: Test each of the hard stops in this section and returns either True/False and the warning statement associated with any hard stop responses.

functions.name: evaluateSection4HardStops()
functions.purpose: Test each of the hard stops in this section and returns either True/False and the warning statement associated with any hard stop responses.

functions.name: evaluateSection5HardStops()
functions.purpose: Test each of the hard stops in this section and returns either True/False and the warning statement associated with any hard stop responses.

functions.name: evaluateHardStops()
functions.purpose: Test each of the hard stopsacross the entire checklist and returns either True/False and the warning statement associated with any hard stop responses.

functions.name: determineDecision()
functions.purpose: Takes anyHardStopTriggered and finalCompositeScore and returns a final GO / NO-GO decision; based on any hard stops triggered and if the final composite score is >= the threshold set by the Risk Tier

functions.name: buildDecisionReasonSummary()
functions.purpose: Generates a concise, human-readable explanation of the decision outcome, including key drivers, failed conditions, and contributing factors.

functions.name: buildDecisionSnapshot()
functions.purpose: Constructs a structured snapshot of the final evaluation state, including scores, thresholds, hard stop status, and decision metadata.

functions.name: validatePrecheckPayload()
functions.purpose: Verifies that all required fields are present, correctly typed, and within acceptable ranges before further processing.

functions.name: normalizedPrecheckPayload()
functions.purpose: Transforms incoming data into canonical field names, formats, and data types to ensure consistency across the system.

functions.name: loadStrategyRule()
functions.purpose: Retrieves the rule configuration and constraints associated with the selected trading strategy.

functions.name: persistTradePrecheckRun()
functions.purpose: Saves the finalized precheck input, evaluation results, and decision outcome to the database for tracking and analysis.

functions.name: submitPrecheckRun()
functions.purpose: Orchestrates the full precheck workflow from input submission through validation, scoring, evaluation, decision, and persistence.

functions.name: formatPrecheckDecisionResult()
functions.purpose: Formats the final decision output into a standardized structure suitable for UI display or API response.
